## DEP-04 — Migration, TLS, API, events (числа)

- Migration: version=1, checksum=`53e37c762d9efd4f8985ad848d33a6a3604c4554e65accb39429d14d62dfdbe7`;
  proof = Job exit 0 → `SELECT version, checksum FROM portal.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1;`
  → VerifySchema (main.go). Не только exit 0.
- DB TLS verify-full: config DBHost/port 5432, sslmode verify-full, sslrootcert /etc/portal/db/ca.crt,
  SNI portal-db-rw.portal.svc, MinVersion TLS1.2, InsecureSkipVerify=false, Fallbacks=0 (poolConfig).
  Proof = успешная миграция/VerifySchema через pool (иначе connect fail). `/readyz` 200 ≠ verify-full
  proof; `ssl=true` ≠ hostname verification. App Ping = store.Ping (3s).
- 11 API (server.go): /api/v1/{health,summary,nodes,workloads,pods,services,storage,backups,database,
  metrics,events} — Basic Auth (401/200), GET/HEAD only. mgmt /livez,/readyz,/startupz на 8081 (НЕ
  открывать через внешний Service; `/healthz` отсутствует).
- Events: timeline_events (dedup_key UNIQUE, TTL 7d, cap 50000, prune ≤1000/statement), observation_batches
  (TTL 7d, cap 20000); readback ListEvents keyset (id DESC, afterID). Без искусственных K8s событий.
- Bounds (accepted plan): request timeout min(15s, remaining W); W=60/30/120s; I=10/5/10s; N≤6;
  **Gateway: W=120s, I=10s, N≤12 в ОДНОМ hard window** (не 12×120s).

## RD-01 — WAL observation (normative DRAFT budget)

Actor/access: авторизованный operator на node-01 (key-only path), НЕ Portal. Binding: named
`portal/portal-db` Cluster `.status.currentPrimary` → named Pod в portal → UID/IP/owner validation →
фиксированный HTTP `Pod IP:9187/metrics`, без redirects. Не infer primary из `cnpg.io/podRole=instance`.
Нет fallback на другой Pod, dynamic retry, exec, port-forward, SQL, Secret read.

**Чтения одного sample (5 запросов, строго по порядку):**
1. GET named Cluster → currentPrimary + Cluster UID.
2. GET named currentPrimary Pod в portal → Pod UID/IP, owner-binding к этому Cluster, container name/restartCount/running.startedAt.
3. HTTP GET fixed Pod IP:9187/metrics (no redirects).
4. GET ТОТ ЖЕ Pod → сравнить identity/IP/container restart/start.
5. GET ТОТ ЖЕ Cluster → сравнить UID/currentPrimary.

Raw response size валидируется ДО персиста; raw objects в evidence не попадают. Metadata projection
ограничена полями выше + name/namespace + required cluster labels. Счётчики/timestamps/reset — из
accepted pg_stat_archiver series.

| Bound | Normative DRAFT value |
|---|---|
| Observation windows | S0, S1, S2a, S2b, S3, S4 — максимум 6 |
| Sample slots в окне | offsets 0, 300, 600s — максимум 3 |
| Per sample | 4 metadata GET + 1 metrics GET = 5 запросов |
| Per request | timeout ≤5s и remaining deadline; один attempt, без retry |
| Per sample deadline | ≤30s (5 запросов ≤25s nominal) |
| Per window hard deadline | 660s от первого slot, monotonic clock |
| Metadata body cap | 256 KiB каждый (до projection) |
| Metric body cap | 1 MiB |
| Per sample body cap | 2 MiB total |
| Per window cap | 15 requests / 6 MiB |
| All six windows cap | 90 requests / 36 MiB / 3960s observation time |
| Total rollout elapsed | observation cap ПЛЮС отдельно bounded action time; НЕ утверждать 3960s |
| Abort | timeout, malformed/nonfinite, missing series, role/UID/IP/restart/reset change → INCONCLUSIVE/STOP |
| Retry distinction | только later planned slots для valid-but-idle; transport/parse failure НЕ retry |

**Verdict:**
- S0 первый valid sample = baseline; later valid slot должен показать fresh natural progress.
- Для каждого post-operation window: retain последний accepted pre-operation sample (same Cluster/Pod
  identity) + записать operation-end UTC. Сравнить failed_count/last_failed_time/reset markers против
  этого retained baseline: рост ошибки побеждает любой рост архивов. Затем require archived_count growth
  И fresh last_archived_time.
- Idle разрешён только до исчерпания оставшихся planned slots, затем INCONCLUSIVE/STOP. Без force WAL/
  writes/backup/искусственного трафика.

**Clock:** future gate должен evidence абсолютный exporter/observer UTC skew bound ≤5s; если неизвестен →
freshness INCONCLUSIVE (без silent clock assumption). PASS: `last_archived_time > operation_end_UTC + 5s`
И `<= sample_end_UTC + 5s` (для S0 — first-sample-end UTC вместо operation-end). Clock evidence сам НЕ
authorized здесь — explicit future gate prerequisite.

Bracketing фиксирует observed changes, не absolute absence transient role change. Не atomic snapshot,
не full S3 readback, не DNS proof. Primary-only — выбранная политика сравнения; archive_mode=always note
остаётся. ContinuousArchiving = ARCH-STATE, отдельно от fresh WAL progress.

# (1) FIRST policy selecting existing CNPG pods: one object with the FULL
#     candidate ingress+egress allowlist (accepted source, NOT runtime-verified).
#     Applying it already isolates CNPG pods.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: p8c-cnpg-existing-flows
  namespace: portal
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
      cnpg.io/podRole: instance
  policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress]
  ingress:
  # CNPG peer replication + instance-manager
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
          cnpg.io/podRole: instance
    ports:
    - port: 5432
    - port: 8000
  # CNPG operator instance-manager calls (reconcile/switchover/restart)
  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: cnpg-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: cloudnative-pg
    ports:
    - port: 8000
  # Portal app: application DB (5432) + CNPG metrics scrape (9187)
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal
    ports:
    - port: 5432
    - port: 9187
  # Migrator Job: application DB bootstrap (5432)
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal-migrator
    ports:
    - port: 5432
  egress:
  # DNS (selector-based, UDP+TCP 53)
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — ClusterIP tuple (pre-DNAT): 10.96.0.1/32:443 only.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.96.0.1/32
    ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — endpoint tuples (post-DNAT): three exact /32:6443, not a /24.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.101/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.102/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.103/32
    ports:
    - port: 6443
      protocol: TCP
  # S3 (SeaweedFS) — per-instance sidecar backup/WAL egress (historical candidate, freshness precheck pending)
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.143.10/32
    ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
  # CNPG peer replication + instance-manager (egress)
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
          cnpg.io/podRole: instance
    ports:
    - port: 5432
    - port: 8000
---

# (3) Portal + migrator flows (before their workloads).
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1

  namespace: portal

  - from:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: envoy-gateway-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/component: proxy
          app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: envoy-gateway
          app.kubernetes.io/name: envoy
          gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name: portal-gateway
          gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-namespace: portal
    ports:
    - port: 8080
  egress:
  # DNS (selector-based, UDP+TCP 53)
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — ClusterIP tuple (pre-DNAT): 10.96.0.1/32:443 only.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.96.0.1/32
    ports:
    - port: 443
      protocol: TCP
  # Kubernetes API — endpoint tuples (post-DNAT): three exact /32:6443, not a /24.
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.101/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.102/32
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.30.140.103/32
    ports:
    - port: 6443
      protocol: TCP
  # CNPG app DB
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
    ports:
    - port: 5432
  # CNPG metrics
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
    ports:
    - port: 9187
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: p8c-migrator-flows
  namespace: portal
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal-migrator
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  # DNS only — migrator has no Kubernetes API egress.
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          cnpg.io/cluster: portal-db
    ports:
    - port: 5432
---
# (4) Envoy dataplane policy: dataplane -> Portal (8080) and its xDS/upstreams.
#     Deployed with the Gateway (namespace of the dataplane pods). Egress-only.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: p8c-portal-dataplane-flows
  namespace: envoy-gateway-system
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/component: proxy
      app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: envoy-gateway
      app.kubernetes.io/name: envoy
      gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name: portal-gateway
      gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-namespace: portal
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  # xDS to Envoy Gateway control-plane (required for dataplane config).
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: envoy-gateway-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          control-plane: envoy-gateway
    ports:
    - port: 18000
  # backend (Portal UI) via Service portal:80 -> container 8080.
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: portal
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app.kubernetes.io/name: pak-portal
    ports:
    - port: 8080
  # DNS
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          k8s-app: kube-dns
    ports:
    - port: 53
      protocol: UDP
    - port: 53
      protocol: TCP
